# Validate the toolkit in SharePoint

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Use this essential checklist for actual SPFx lifecycle, authentication, effective permissions, persistence and interaction. A procedure is not execution evidence: record each affected boundary as PASS, FAIL, NOT EXECUTED or BLOCKED, separately from local simulations and builds.

[Documentation home](../../INDEX.md) · [Development](../INDEX.md) · [Repository setup](../setup.md)

## Prepare a validation run

Use an authorized test tenant/site, authenticated account and modern page with a Top placeholder. Record host/site, account role, browser/toolchain and package versions. Prepare disposable list items, keys or files only where the run authorizes those writes; keep a ledger of every physical destination and original sample/page settings. Never delete existing stores, change grants or provision resources merely to manufacture a test condition.

Follow [repository setup](../setup.md), build library before app and restart serve after library edits. Choose checks using [verification scope](../verification.md#verification-scope); full gates are not an unconditional host-setup step. In [serve.json](../../../apps/spfx-react-toolkit-test/config/serve.json), replace `{tenantDomain}`, set `initialPage` to the authenticated workbench and each `pageUrl` to an existing modern page. Preserve the configured Application Customizer action ID `4c2e58cc-1253-43e5-bfa3-b22a07ace279`. Trust the development certificate and run `npm run serve`, or `npm run serve -- --config=spFxReactToolkitTest` for the named extension configuration. Accept debug scripts only for the test session.

Add **SPFxReactToolkitTest** twice in the hosted workbench. Open the configured modern page for the Application Customizer Top banner. Use the [bootstrap/debug-culture procedure](../setup.md#hosted-workbench-bootstrap-and-debug-culture) when manifest discovery or native language matters. Existing consent, accessible resources and supported iframe behavior are prerequisites; unavailable cases remain BLOCKED or NOT EXECUTED. No tenant operation is authorized by reading this checklist.

## Provider and lifecycle boundaries

The actual [WebPart](../../../apps/spfx-react-toolkit-test/src/webparts/spFxReactToolkitTest/SpFxReactToolkitTestWebPart.ts) mounts its WebPart provider; the [Application Customizer](../../../apps/spfx-react-toolkit-test/src/extensions/spFxReactToolkitTest/SpFxReactToolkitTestApplicationCustomizer.ts) mounts/disposes its matching provider with the Top placeholder. Field Customizer and ListView Command Set are export/sample coverage only here: mark their real-host lifecycle NOT EXECUTED without dedicated mounted hosts.

- Record distinct instance IDs. Change properties and scoped local/session values in A; B remains independent. Save/reload only if authorized, and confirm the same instance's persistence. After hook property setters, edit the native Property Pane and verify the next host render is authoritative. Top-level replacement/deletion needs an instrumented host; nested in-place mutation is not deep-observed.
- Switch Read/Edit/Read, theme and container size; verify actual context, dimensions and UI. Remove an instance with work pending. Dispose/recreate the Top placeholder; a late old-placeholder callback must not unmount its replacement. Inspect stale UI, errors and cleanup without claiming universal leak freedom from one run.

## Permissions, denial and absence

The actual [solution manifest](../../../apps/spfx-react-toolkit-test/config/package-solution.json) declares Graph `User.Read` and `GroupMember.Read.All`. Configuration and served debug scripts do not grant consent. Record existing approved scopes, account and endpoint; token/precheck success is neither a grants inventory nor server authorization. OneDrive app-root operations require the applicable `Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder` or `Files.ReadWrite` delegation; other endpoints need their own permissions. Missing approvals require the separately authorized administrator workflow.

Test permitted, denied, missing and invalid targets distinctly. A failed read with an empty/undefined fallback is not confirmed absence; inspect error channels. Access trims control rendering, while the server still authorizes operations. In actual trim panels verify Loading, Denied and Error separately, protected content/effect mounts, and immediate removal of former content when target/user/provider changes. Exercise scoped web/list/item/folder reads and group paging with available accounts. Graph limited-information or hidden-membership omissions are not proof of nonmembership. See [permissions](../../guides/permissions.md) and [picker constraints](../../guides/pickers.md) rather than duplicating endpoint/API matrices.

## Remote requests and partial success

Throttle and overlap reads; change list/key/file/query/provider during pending work and verify current identity wins for data/error/loading. Dispatched remote writes can still complete: local stale-result guards are not cancellation. Record cases requiring controlled response reversal as NOT EXECUTED if the real service cannot reproduce them.

Exercise disposable CRUD, paging, search/refiners/suggestions and failure/retry through explicit actions. Inspect actual configured web and decoded title/GUID/URL/path list selectors, numeric item IDs and special-character requests using [list integration](../../guides/helpers-and-services.md#compare-react-list-selectors). For multipart batches use an instrumented provider-wrapped component when the panel lacks actions. Inspect individual statuses and returned IDs: successful writes remain after partial failure, hook error may accompany a resolved batch, and service/selector/execution failure may reject. Confirm server state before retry or cleanup. Do not infer query suggestions from indexed documents or treat a failed catalog read as a successful empty catalog.

## Storage destinations and persistence

Use [storage contracts](../../guides/storage.md) for semantics. Record physical browser scope, OneDrive file, collection-root store and tenant-catalog store separately. Confirm site root/subsite sharing only where existing accessible subsites permit it; another collection stays isolated. For layered configuration, verify site override/tenant fallback and provenance, explicit mutation destination, and physical absence after removal. A denied site read must not masquerade as absence/fallback.

Confirm mount/read/selection changes do not provision stores or dispatch writes; provisioning belongs to an explicit authorized save. OneDrive reads should use `createIfMissing: false` unless creation is deliberately tested. Check effective list/root/catalog grants and actual server success rather than role names or advisory `canWrite`. Exercise formats, description omission versus clearing, browser invalid JSON/storage denial and server missing/denied data as applicable. Record schema, pagination and observed If-Match/HTTP 412 conflicts; preserve changed data instead of blind retries or wildcard overwrite. Generic types do not validate persisted values. Only a disposable authorized destination may be used for schema/first-save tests.

## Native Property Pane and hosted picker writes

In the real nonreactive pane, select and confirm a draft, close/reopen, Apply an accepted draft and Discard another; verify authoritative reset, hydration and saved references without incidental JSON rewrites. Test disposal while confirmation/read is pending, scope changes, current-session focus and separate document/theme ownership. React/local fixture acceptance does not establish native Apply/save/reopen.

For [FileFolderPicker](../../api/controls/file-folder-picker.md) and its [native field](../../api/property-pane/file-folder-picker.md), verify source containment from actual collection/library/folder metadata, current-user OneDrive ownership and resource-specific authentication. An entry URL or supplied token does not establish route access; a FilePicker.aspx URL does not prove Graph independence. Distinguish empty, denied, unsupported and inaccessible iframe traffic. Record internal hosted requests as unverified when tooling cannot observe them. Cancellation or metadata failure must retain saved references; it does not undo remote operations. Upload/create/device/link commands may write **before Pick**, and Cancel/Discard cannot roll those writes back. Test such commands only with separately authorized content and destination; never broaden sources or grants silently.

## Localization and instance isolation

Follow [native localization setup](../../guides/localization.md). Register resources through consumer postinstall, then rebuild/restart. Compare actual UI culture with regional formatting culture, Italian and unsupported-culture resource requests, and two instances with distinct dictionaries. Preserve drafts/history and avoid language/theme-triggered property publication. In Context, compare fixed January/July UTC instants against the site's representative IANA zone, recording the raw SharePoint numeric zone ID and mapped value. An unavailable mapping must not present the browser/runtime zone as the site zone; culture and offsets alone do not establish equivalence. Microsoft's hosted iframe language is separate from toolkit labels. Record resource URLs/manifest IDs, fallback and lazy loading; a mapping or packed asset is not authenticated loader evidence.

## Focus, input and accessibility

Use actual keyboard/pointer and an identified screen reader/device where available. Check labels/descriptions/heading hierarchy, visible focus, native navigation, narrow regions, RTL, host theme, forced colors and native 200% zoom. For [DataGrid](../../api/controls/data-grid.md), inspect header/selection announcements, action isolation, overflow and chart summary alternatives. For [SettingsGroup](../../api/controls/settings-group.md) and [AccordionGroup](../../api/controls/accordion-group.md), verify caller-owned labels, retained note state and that closed retained panels leave the Tab order; explicit unmount may reset state.

Check modal/nested popup Escape, focus restoration and hidden/inert content. Device IME, touch and clipboard must be observed on the actual device; synthetic composition/paste cannot establish them. Verify title/form save/reset/reopen only within authorized persistence actions. Teams, other Microsoft 365 hosts and iframe ownerDocument/portal behavior remain NOT EXECUTED until separately exercised. Consult each [control reference](../../api/INDEX.md#references) for feature-specific expectations rather than treating this checklist as an API/default catalog.

## Record results and clean up

For each affected boundary record PASS (observed match), FAIL (observed mismatch), NOT EXECUTED (not run) or BLOCKED (specific missing prerequisite), with timestamp, host/account role, browser/device/assistive technology, expected/actual behavior, reproduction, redacted console/network/screenshots and limitations. Never retain tokens or sensitive debug query parameters. Record source, compiled fixture, packed consumer and authenticated observations separately; no old dated PASS applies to a new run.

Keep run evidence under local `.docs/maintenance/`; public procedures must work without those files. Remove only run-created items/files/keys from each ledger destination and confirm physical absence through fresh reads/inventories. Preserve existing lists, unrelated data, grants and original page/settings; close only run-created tabs and restore test selections. Mark incomplete cleanup explicitly. Deployment, tenant approval, publication and destructive setup require separate authorization.
